summary: Build practical shared services and BPO capability in SLAs, process control, KPIs, automation, and change. Explore the course and enrol your team.
lede: Shared services training covers designing and governing centralized finance, HR, and procurement operations. It is for shared services professionals, functional managers, and transformation leaders who need to map and standardize processes, define service catalogues and service-level agreements, and assess controls. Participants also practise prioritizing automation and planning transitions and KPI dashboards to monitor service performance.
audienceIntro: Shared services professionals, functional managers, transformation leaders, and public-sector modernization specialists can use this course to design or scale centralized and outsourced operations. It suits professionals who need a cross-functional view of service delivery, governance, process control, technology adoption, and workforce transition.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to at least one business function such as finance, HR, procurement, customer support, operations, or public-service administration. No coding or programming experience is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets, process documentation, service metrics, or organizational change will help you apply the exercises more quickly.
